title: Fragmented
overview: Following a traumatic accident, Miguel is left in a fractured psychological state where memory, perception, and imagination begin to overlap. As fragmented recollections surface-anchored by emotionally significant moments with a close friend-he struggles to distinguish between what is real and what is constructed by his mind. Seeking clarity, he attempts to organize these experiences into a coherent internal narrative, treating them as disjointed pieces of a larger unresolved whole.
